english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone's fame or reputation.
This is the all-purpose choice for being famous or widely known.
This is the all-purpose everyday noun for fame or wide recognition.
Use this when the reputation mainly means how famous or well-known someone is.
Use this when referring to fame or how well-known someone is rather than to the person.

examples.english: He gained fame in Hong Kong through singing.
examples.traditional: 佢靠唱歌喺香港闖出名氣。
